text: Verbal report from the Department of Water and Power on federal cuts to Colorado River imports, the effects that will have on water sales from the Metropolitan Water District of Southern California, and changes to conservation efforts for Angelenos.
summary: The Department of Water and Power will give a verbal report on how federal cuts to Colorado River imports will affect water sales from the Metropolitan Water District, and how conservation efforts for residents will change.
